verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a back-office SaaS platform, so the story applies. However, the evidence shows no documented bulk actions on mail, compliance items, filings or other records. The only multi-item mention is submitting one pre-filled application to several partner services at once (firstbase-docs-13), which is an adjacent convenience rather than a bulk-operations capability, and no API or OpenAPI spec was found for programmatic bulk work.
